ProblemJson.description: One problem as `mt check --json` prints it.

file.description: The file the problem sits in, `/`-separated, or `null`.

hints.description: The next steps the report names.

line.description: The line in that file, or `null`.

message.description: The problem's message, without its place or rule.

place.description: The text the plain report starts with, `/`-separated like `file`.

rule.description: The rule that refused the task, or `null`.

description: The object `mt check --json` prints: the problems it found, in print order.

$schema.description: The URL of the schema this object conforms to.

problems.description: The problems in print order, each as the text report shows it.

title: Mindtape check
